evals.name: Generated instructions fit their target fields
evals.prompt: Run setup once for each subfolder of the fixture (priya-plus, priya-free, darnell), using that subfolder's capabilities.json, user_script.md and sources. At the end of each run, list every generated helper instruction with: helper, where it will be installed (target field), the character limit you used for that field (or 'no published limit'), and its character count.
evals.expected_output: Three setups. Priya on Plus gets an on-demand prep instruction in custom instructions of at most 5,000 chars; on Free the same request is either cut to at most 1,500 chars or moved to a project with only a short pointer in custom instructions; Darnell's board-prep agent instructions are at most 8,000 chars with a description under 1,000 and name under 30. Each run reports the limit used and accurate counts.
expectations: priya-plus: the custom-instructions text is at most 5,000 characters, and the report names 5,000 as the limit used

priya-free: the custom-instructions text is at most 1,500 characters (either a lean prep instruction or a short pointer to a project holding the full helper), and the report names 1,500 as the limit used
darnell: the Board meeting prep agent's instructions are at most 8,000 characters, its description at most 1,000 and its name at most 30, and the report names these limits
Scheduled task / scheduled prompt bodies are reported as 'no published limit' (not given an invented number)
Every reported character count is within 5% of the actual length of the text it describes
No run recommends a custom GPT
